description: Headcount are proud to deliver this limited edition 7" vinyl by French R&B artist Ta-Ra. Side A houses her brand new single 'Room 77', produced by long time collaborator NxxxxxS whilst the flip side celebrates the 5th anniversary of their cult banger 'LIL BIT' which started it all.
credits:
Side A - Room 77
Side B - LIL BIT

vocals by Ta-Ra
produced by NxxxxxS
